description:
Six of seven jmap-*-types crates carry byte-identical copies of src/string_enum.rs (md5: 4785cdca09f58b44ae8ec69d0f320187 in calendars, chat, filenode, mail, sharing, tasks). The seventh — jmap-contacts-types — differs by exactly one line (a #[allow(unused_macros)] attribute, md5: f26fca43f347dae76f37bd529338e80e). Pure duplication.

The macro produces a #[non_exhaustive] enum with a Custom(String) variant that round-trips unknown values through serde — used for open-ended JMAP enums where the spec allows vendor-specific extensions (e.g. AddressBookProperty, CalendarEventProperty, NotificationType). Every JMAP type crate needs this pattern.

## Goal

Promote string_enum! to jmap-types (locked) and have each type crate re-export it (or import from jmap-types directly) instead of carrying a local copy.

## Scope

- Add crate-jmap-types/src/string_enum.rs (copy from any of the 6 identical hosts).
- Re-export in lib.rs: 'pub use string_enum::*;' or 'pub use string_enum::string_enum;'.
- Round-trip tests in jmap-types covering: known variant serialize/deserialize, Custom(String) round-trip, #[non_exhaustive] cannot be matched without _ arm.
- Delete the 7 local copies.
- Each downstream type crate: replace 'use crate::string_enum;' (or local definition) with 'use jmap_types::string_enum;'.
- Verify no consumer broke: 'cargo test --workspace' clean.

## Out of scope

- Changing the macro's behaviour or syntax.
- Touching the existing string_enum! call sites (the macro arguments) inside each crate's enum definitions.
- Deprecating local re-exports (each type crate may keep 'pub use jmap_types::string_enum;' if useful for downstream ergonomics).

## Approval gate

This adds public API to jmap-types (locked). Per the workspace AGENTS.md locked-crate rule, requires explicit per-change approval from Mark before landing. Filing this bead just makes the work discoverable.

## Source material

- crate-jmap-mail-types/src/string_enum.rs — canonical baseline (one of the 6 identical copies)
- crate-jmap-contacts-types/src/string_enum.rs — variant with the extra #[allow] attribute (decide whether to absorb the attribute or document why contacts needs it)
notes:
Implementation complete 2026-05-08.

Approach: added #[macro_export] macro_rules! impl_string_enum! at crate-jmap-types/src/string_enum.rs (152 LoC including 6 round-trip unit tests) and mod string_enum; in crate-jmap-types/src/lib.rs.

Cascade: removed #[macro_use] mod string_enum; from each of the 7 type-crate lib.rs files, deleted the 7 local string_enum.rs files (6 byte-identical, 1 differing only in #[allow(unused_macros)]), and added 'use jmap_types::{impl_string_enum, Id, ...};' to the 12 call-site source files.

Contacts special case: jmap-contacts-types had zero impl_string_enum!() invocations (the #[allow(unused_macros)] attribute existed precisely because the macro was dead code). The file is simply deleted in contacts; no use statement needed.

Net delta: ~324 LoC removed across the workspace.

Quality gates passed:
- cargo build --workspace clean
- cargo test --workspace clean (6 new tests in jmap-types pass; 16 existing call-site tests across the type crates still pass)
- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings clean
- cargo fmt --all -- --check clean
- RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc --no-deps clean for all 8 affected type crates

Pre-existing scope NOT touched: jmap-mail-server has a pre-existing rustdoc error on intra-doc link [MdnBackend] (feature-gated). Exists on main without my changes, unrelated to JMAP-wk77.

Locked-crate compliance: explicit user approval was obtained before touching jmap-types, jmap-mail-types, and jmap-chat-types (all on the locked list per workspace AGENTS.md). The other 4 affected type crates (calendars, contacts, filenode, sharing, tasks) are not on the locked list.

Public-API delta on jmap-types: +1 #[macro_export] macro 'impl_string_enum!' at the crate root. Zero breaking changes to existing types/fields/derives/serde attrs.
title: Consolidate string_enum! macro into jmap-types
